DISPOSITION OF FORMER K.C.C. SECTIONS 
 
UPDATED:  September 9, 2026 
 
 
This table contains a numerical list of K.C.C. sections no longer appearing in the code 
because of the repeal, expiration, decodification, or recodification of the sections.  Each 
entry gives the affected K.C.C. number, its caption, and the section's ordinance source and 
disposition.  The text of the section can be found by referring to the ordinance source citation 
contained in brackets.
